_readme: Sarvam AI per-character list-price estimates (USD per 1,000 characters), converted from published INR rates. NOT pulled from a live billing API and NOT verified against actual Sarvam invoices — verify against real provider billing before using any cost figure derived from this file in a hospital-facing or funding claim. Sarvam bills per character, not per token, so this is a separate rate table from pricing.json (which is token-shaped, for the doctor/compressor/critic/closing-turn LLM calls) rather than an extra entry in it.

translate._source: https://docs.sarvam.ai/api-reference-docs/pricing — ₹0.005/char (₹50 per 10,000 chars) for the translate API — looked up Sept 2026, currently the live translate model (mayura:v1, src/diffdx/legacy_store.py)

tts._source: https://www.sarvam.ai/api-pricing — ₹30 per 10,000 chars for text-to-speech — looked up Sept 2026, currently the live TTS model (bulbul:v2, src/diffdx/legacy_store.py)
